answer: Make every agent keep its own light on. Each identity registers one public endpoint it alone controls, its small haven on the network, no shared hosting. Each epoch, five random peers probe it twenty times; miss over 1% and a $5 fine comes out of the agent's $30 prepaid bond, which must be topped up. Every fake identity needs its own server, about $4 a month on a cheap VPS. One thousand fakes costs $4,000 a month to keep the grove of endpoints lit. Clusters on one IP range get a violet mark and must move to separate providers at full price.
